utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you heard about the repair drive too? I can tell you what I know, but it’s still a bit thin.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I heard the drive’s starting soon, and folks are saying it’s for the old storefront and the community hall. That’s all I know for now, but I’ll pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can keep folks posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help, but I need the actual user request or conversation content to respond correctly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I just need the actual request or conversation details, then I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Please send the actual repair drive request or conversation details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive. What still needs to be done?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need more hands, tools, and a few lumber and wire donations. I’ve got the list started, but I’m missing the rest of the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that, but I need the details on the repair drive first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve got the details here: it’s a neighborhood repair drive for helping fix up homes, and I can fill you in on the sign-up and schedule if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can help with the sign-up and schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Oren. Let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll help you sort it out step by step.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think it’s the front gate and maybe that loose kitchen hinge, but let me check and we can go one by one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that’s a start. Check the gate first, then the hinge, and tell me which one needs the quickest fix.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Pia, we’re putting together the repair drive this week, and I’d love to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can come, but I’ll need to know the time and whether there’s parking first so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s this Thursday at 6, and yes, there’s parking out front and along the side street.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is moving along, but I only got that second-hand. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s on track. We’ve got the list together, and I’m checking a couple last details before we start booking the actual repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to hear. When do you think you’ll start booking people in?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do we know what time the repair drive starts? I want to make sure I have the details right before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think it starts at 10 a.m., but I’d double-check the flyer before you go.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll check the flyer before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I need a little time to think about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Take your time, Uli. I can swing back later and help once you've thought it through.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll let you know once I’ve had a moment to think it through.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a few clamps if that helps. Just tell me what the repair drive needs most.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can also swing by with my screwdriver set and a tape measure. Tell me which repairs are highest priority and I’ll bring what’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the route here, but I need the repair drive location before I can mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s the one by the old maintenance shed, near the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll mark the repair drive down by the old maintenance shed near the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Let’s start with the back gate hinge; it’s been sticking.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a screwdriver and some lubricant; I’ll take a look at that hinge now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know the schedule and who’s covering the pickups before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the schedule and who’s on pickup duty before I say yes?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can only commit once I’ve got the schedule and pickup names in hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help coordinate a bit if you want — I know a couple people who’d probably be glad to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a big help, Jules. I can pull together the list and you can start reaching out to the folks you know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’ll start reaching out and let you know what I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few extra tarps and a box of screws if the drive needs them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll set these aside in case we need them. If you hear of anything else missing, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is still on for Saturday, and folks are saying the sign-up sheet is filling up fast.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I should be able to make it for part of Saturday, but I need to work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s fine, just come when you can, and I’ll make sure someone saves you a spot on the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, just point me to what needs fixing and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Bo. I’ll walk the block with you and point out the spots that need attention.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely, lead the way and I’ll keep an eye out for the trouble spots.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the basics: a Phillips screwdriver, a flashlight, and a couple spare batteries.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, I’ll bring those by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Nell. I’m telling folks about the repair drive now, and I’ll send anyone who can help your way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep an ear out for anyone who can help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll keep spreading the word and send anyone I find your way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can point you to the repair drive entrance if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, that would help. Point me to it and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure thing, it’s just past the corner by the old oak, then straight down the gravel path to the repair drive gate.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is the repair drive still on for this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still on for this week. I’m just checking the final details now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, when should we expect the final details?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re still gathering parts for the repair drive. I can stop by after my errand and see what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, that'd help a lot. If you spot the missing parts, let me know and I'll keep track of the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll swing by after I’m done and check the parts that are still missing.
